scope: Read-only source review across UI request/confirmation, Controller scopes/gates, Core previews, native CSV backend/parser wrapper; actual UI execution is separately reported in ui/validation.json.
observations: Explicit CurrentCellNo must be positive and match displayed _cell; overview/focus cannot infer scope. Controller independently selects only cell keys.
Reference source ResolveF semantics are retained; target snapshot uses absolute F, not target B + copied F.
Per-cell preview initially repeated whole Init-set creation; reviewed the revised PreviewBulkCorrectionByCell sharing one lookup and one population pass.
Export streams and SHA-checks authoritative bytes under a read lease, protects active/config/foreign-model/reparse destinations, stages temp output and checks current frame again before move.
Import reuses native parser, validates known/hidden Cell-Shot rows, measurement state and unknown-head SCANNER conversion, and creates a draft rather than immediately saving.

Modal export owns the Controller command gate; sync queues _source replacement. Native selected-model changes are checked by backend EnsureCurrent. Same-model newer saved revision is intentionally latest-snapshot export.
Raw CSV does not embed Recipe identity; external CSV origin cannot be cryptographically proven. UI/import description and explicit current-model draft-save confirmation must remain.
